The '''Beastmark Hills''' was the name given to the southern part in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Beastmark Hills appears as a location in the Old Paths on Voss in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
